description: This PHP source file defines the API endpoint class ValidationProjectActivityNameAPI within the OrangeHRM Time plugin module. The class handles validation of project activity names for uniqueness, providing an API for checking if a project activity name is available or already taken, optionally considering an existing activity ID. It includes validation rules, request processing logic, and Swagger/OpenAPI annotations for documentation.
